title: The detention bus that could not leave
situation: Police are loading detained protesters onto a bus. A woman protester takes the bus key and runs into the crowd; without the key the bus cannot move.

when.note: IndieBuzz caption says "shared October 3"; filming date and first uploader unestablished.

who.officer: Delhi Police constables and the bus driver

lines.text: So, this is the girl who took the bus key and ran. 😹😹😹
lines.speaker: X caption, @Delhiite_

lines.text: Gen-Z ने पुलिस के साथ खेला Subway Surfers! जंतर मंतर 2.0 पर बस की चाबी लेकर भागी दीदी!
lines.speaker: Boldsky video headline

lines.text: IndieBuzz caption claims the driver laughed.
lines.speaker: reposter caption

reactionBeats: Not described by any source. Caption claims the driver laughed; unverified.

quoted.text: Wo stree hai, kuch bhi kar sakti hai 😂
quoted.speaker: Instagram commenter

paraphrased: Some praised her boldness; others asked whether it was legal (Aaj Tak, NewsBytes).
One Instagram commenter said it obstructed official duty.

phaseNote: Detentions were under way; in game this is the 14:00+ detention-bus window.
context: Same day police reported about 15 personnel injured and about 110 detained (Aaj Tak, NewsBytes).

buildThis.situation: Lift the key off Iqbal's dashboard hook while he argues with a constable; the detention bus dies mid-route and detainees start eyeing the rear door.

doNotInfer: that the driver laughed (caption claim only)
that there were no legal consequences
